name: Dúnmharú Manor
source:
Our protagonist, James, is driving to a charming little dinner party hosted by the esteemed politician Sean Flynn. He will be joined by five others for a night they won’t soon forget.

[From [url=https://toastedmochavt.itch.io/dnmhar-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们的主人公詹姆斯正开车去参加由受人尊敬的政治家肖恩·弗林主办的一个迷人的小型晚宴。另外五人将与他一起度过一个他们不会很快忘记的夜晚。

[来自[url=https://toastedmochavt.itch.io/dnmhar-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
